## Description

Briefly describe the change and the rationale behind it.

- Closes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality or provider)
- [ ] Performance improvement / Refactoring
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Packaging / CI update

## Checklist

- [ ] Code compiles and tests pass locally (`cargo test`)
- [ ] Formatting follows conventions (`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy`)
- [ ] Relevant documentation or configuration examples updated
- [ ] Tested under a live Wayland compositor (e.g. Sway, Hyprland, River)
